title: Abada tool server
description: An MCP tool server a project's agents may use, with the policy of each tool. A tool not listed is denied.

name.description: Server name used in APL tool references (<name>/<tool>). Unique per project.

transport.description: Only MCP streamable HTTP in 1.1; stdio is not supported.

credential.description: Name of a project tool credential sent as a bearer token. Never the secret itself.

idempotency.description: key: the server accepts an idempotency key, so a resumed write is re-sent with the same key. none: a write interrupted by a crash is never re-sent; it opens an incident. Required for write and approval_required.

approvers.description: Groups that may approve an approval_required call.

input_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical (key-sorted) JSON of the tool's inputSchema; the worker refuses the tool when the server's schema differs.
